articles.title: ACOG Guideline Backs Early Hormone Therapy for Menopause Symptoms
articles.excerpt: (MedPage Today) -- Updated guidelines from the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) expand on previous recommendations and align with a growing cross-specialty consensus on how to manage menopause symptoms. For managing vasomotor...
articles.summary: MedPage Today报道，ACOG更新指南，支持对更年期症状早期使用激素治疗，扩展既往建议并与跨专科共识一致，涉及血管舒缩症状管理。
